changes: Settings layout: Recovery keys sits directly above Information, using the same compact controls. Password and device-authentication requirements remain unchanged.
Recovery-key privacy fix: leaving the key screen clears displayed keys immediately, before the next screen renders. Returning requires authorization again.

Retains Settings recovery controls for all 18 coins: 200 keys per coin, ten per page, with address/public-key/private-key copy controls and existing password, device-authentication, expiry and clipboard protections.

Reliable recovery checks: bounded test waits accommodate slow first-time wallet creation and restoration. A busy-renderer regression test verifies the old timeout case without weakening failure assertions.

Safer publication: both wallet/packaging and Android security jobs must pass on the exact merged source commit. Missing, pending, skipped, failed or cancelled checks block publication; earlier PR results are not sufficient.
Clearer CI diagnostics: safe timeout categories and browser test locations identify failures without publishing wallet data.
Compatibility: no changes to addresses, seed paths, JSON backups, fee calculations or transaction signing. No wallet data, signing keys or Electrum service changes are included.

Android update: versionCode 23, debugging disabled, using the existing development signing identity. Test.22 remains available. Update in place without uninstalling or clearing wallet data; this remains an unaudited development prerelease.
